content.text: {"core": "Breakthrough ruptures the containing structure and forces held pressure into the open. In Change, it operates on transition itself: the process that ends one form and seats the next. Too Much, rupture arrives before transition completes, breaking each successor form while it is still taking shape, so nothing seated survives to become the ground the next ending needs.", "sheetLine": "Each new form shatters before it sets; the breaking outpaces what it breaks open."}
